name: Saeki Asuna
source:
A schoolgirl working part-time at Kisaragi Shrine, and a friend of [url=/c20389]Yuma's[/url].

She's very chatty, so she'll often exchange gossip with Yuma, but has a tendency to occasionally say something without thinking and kill the conversation.

Despite having a favorable relationship with the protagonist, they still somehow get caught up in numerous arguments since that's just the type of girl she is.

[spoiler]Works together with [url=/c20479]Yomi[/url] in keeping an eye on [url=/c48508]Nayu[/url], and helps to try and retrieve the Necronomicon from her. Additionally she is [url=/c48608]Saeki Yuugo[/url]'s older fraternal twin sister. And on top of that she is also dead; thus her brother had been trying to bring her back to life.[/spoiler]
